jobs.description:
**About First Due**



First Due’s mission is to prevent first responder injury or death by providing fire and EMS agencies with transformative, end\-to\-end software solutions that empower them to run safer, smarter, and more effective operations.

### **Job Title: Manager, Sales Enablement**


**Location**: Remote \- US Only  

**Country**: United States  

**Department**: Sales  

**Position Type**: Full\-Time  

**Salary**: $140,000



### **Job Summary:**



We are hiring a **Manager, Sales Enablement** to deeply partner with GTM and drive actionable accelerated outcomes. We want someone who sees the function of Sales Enablement as a revenue problem rather than a training problem. The job will be measured on ramp time, certification, and win rates, not on how much training gets delivered.



This is a highly hands\-on role. You should expect to write the playbook and then run reps through it yourself: leading live sessions, reviewing call recordings, sitting in on demos, and building and managing the certification program.



### **Key Responsibilities:**


* **Rep ramp and productivity**
	+ You will own time\-to\-first\-deal for new AEs. Onboarding should be built around real pipeline, live customer conversations, and recorded calls, so that new hires are selling early rather than watching slide decks. You'll also build and manage a tiered certification program covering trade\-show fluency, demo certification, and full\-suite certification, with live evaluated practice at each level. Completing a video course doesn't count as a credential here.
* **AI\-driven coaching at scale**
	+ We have more than 30 reps, so ride\-alongs alone won't work. We expect you to use AI heavily: call analysis, coaching, content personalization, and rep self\-service, built on our current GTM stack. In practice that means managing a coaching loop that surfaces deal risk, demo quality, talk\-track adherence, and discovery gaps to each rep and their Regional Sales Director every week. It also means building reusable AI assistants for things like objection handling, battlecards, discovery prep, and account research. Every tool should be tied to an outcome. If something isn't moving win rate, ramp time, or activity quality, we stop paying for it.
* **Product and competitive fluency**
	+ An early and non\-negotiable goal: every AE can hold a 15\-minute overview conversation across the full product suite at a trade show without a solution consultant in the room. From there, the longer\-term work is building the habits that let reps land and expand across RMS, ePCR, scheduling, training, command, and reporting from the first call, supported by competitive playbooks and displacement plays.
* **Content and sales tools**
	+ Audit the existing collateral in your first 60 days. Keep what reps actually use and what converts, and rebuild or retire the rest. Reps should never have to wonder which deck, pricing sheet, or battlecard is current, so part of this job is maintaining a single source of truth. The same standard applies to the tool stack: every tool should have an owner, an adoption target, and a connection to a sales metric.
* **Partnership with sales leadership**
	+ You'll partner closely with sales leadership to identify coaching priorities region by region. A significant part of the job is helping our four Regional Sales Directors become better coaches and ensuring reps receive consistent, actionable coaching. You'll also keep a tight loop with Solution Consulting and Product on demo discipline, sandbox usage, and new\-feature enablement so that product launches turn into pipeline quickly.

### **Qualifications:**


* Five or more years in B2B SaaS sales, sales enablement, sales engineering, or sales management, including experience directly supporting or owning enablement programs
* A track record you can point to: ramp time you reduced, win rates you moved, or a certification program that changed how reps actually sell
* Hands\-on experience with Gong or a similar platform, modern outbound tooling, LMS platforms, and CRM workflows
* Real working fluency with AI. You are already building custom GPTs or similar assistants, automating call review, and using AI for coaching and content, not just reading about it
* Field credibility. Reps will trust you faster if you can take the call and run the demo yourself, so a background as a high\-performing AE, sales manager, or sales engineer is a strong plus
* Experience selling into public safety, healthcare, govtech, or other vertical or regulated markets helps
* Comfort with ambiguity. We are moving fast, and you will not get a perfect org chart or a finished tech stack before results are expected
* Willingness to identify what's broken across content, tools, and sales execution and then help drive the fix
**For US\-based Roles**  

All applicants must be authorized to work for any US employer in the United States. Locality Media LLC is unable to sponsor or transition sponsorship ownership of employment visas at this time. Hiring is contingent upon candidates successfully passing a criminal background check. As part of the I\-9 verification of authorization to work in the US, Locality Media participates in E\-Verify.  

  

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**  

This role is fully remote with minimal travel expectations at this time. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable qualified employees and applicants to perform the essential functions as outlined above. If you require an accommodation during the interview process, please reach out to people@firstdue.com.  

  

**Working at First Due**  

First Due offers a comprehensive compensation and benefits package for eligible employees, including competitive pay, medical, dental, and vision coverage, FSA/HSA, 401(k), flexible PTO, a fully remote workplace, a technology stipend, opportunities for advancement, and other benefits and perks that sets our team apart. Visit www.firstdue.com to learn more.

jobs.description:
Department Overview:

This position is responsible for managed care, insurance verification and patient price estimate processes within the Centralized Managed Care \& Price Estimates (CMC) department. This position supports the OHSU systems and operations of ambulatory practices, professional services and hospital departments. This position works closely with internal and external customers including Intake Coordinators, Clinical Staff, Surgery Schedulers, Care Managers, Financial Counselors, Insurance Companies, PCP Office Staff, and CMC Leadership to ensure patients receive optimal financial services related to their care.  

The Managed Care Coordinator and Insurance Verification \& Patient Estimates Specialist are an integral part of the CMC team by providing clear and accurate information regarding our patients' financial obligations related to their visits, treatments, procedures and/or hospital admissions. This role is responsible for obtaining and/or verifying prior authorizations, verifying benefits, creating cost estimates, contacting patients to provide estimates, offer pre\-service payment opportunity and collecting pre\-service payments for visits, treatments, procedures and/or hospital admissions. This position is also responsible for providing guidance for other staff in the areas of patient liabilities, health care contract terms, complex patient referrals, and other managed care issues.  

The incumbent will have an extensive knowledge of Managed Care and Insurance Verification processes in the ambulatory and inpatient setting including but not limited to insurance eligibility, benefits verification and authorization requirements. This role is knowledgeable about the Epic system and current best practice referral and prior authorization workflows. The incumbent is able to provide support and backup to the Centralized Managed Care \& Price Estimates Department as needed for cross\-coverage for all managed care and insurance verification workflows.
Function/Duties of Position:
**Centralized Managed Care and Insurance Verification*** Review incoming referral orders to assess patient’s needs based on diagnosis, insurance coverage or lack thereof, and previous treatments. Referrals may be received internally via Epic or externally via fax or other methods.
* Verify patient information including demographics, insurance coverage and financial status. Confirm patient eligibility for health care coverage and clarify any managed care arrangements. Document any details related to liability insurance (i.e. motor vehicle accident, personal injury, or worker’s compensation) to determine third party liability.
* Obtains benefit information including current eligibility, deductible or co\-pays, co\-insurance, stoploss or out of pocket status, authorization requirements, PCP referral requirements, days approved (for routine admissions), and correct billing address.
* Document information based on department protocols in the Epic Referral shell.
* Work closely with referring providers to obtain necessary insurance referrals and authorizations.
* For urgent/emergent admissions, provides admit information and sets up authorizations and/or PCP referrals. Contacts care\-management to provide clinical review and obtain length of stay.
* For routine admissions, confirms that the authorizations and/or PCP referrals cover the designated admission. new_jobs.title: Program Manager – El Mercadito/Arcoiris
new_jobs.description:
Mission Action has been growing rapidly, therefore, we have created a lot of new positions across our different programs and departments. Please consider joining our team to serve the communities.


Mission Action nurtures individual wellness and cultivates collective power among low\-income and immigrant communities to create a more just society. As a multi\-issue, multi\-strategy organization, we work to improve lives on an individual level as well as affect broader social change by engaging in advocacy and community organizing. We work together across programs to address homelessness, lack of affordable housing, and to support immigrant rights in order to meet the complex needs of our communities and collectively address the root causes of suffering and injustice. To learn more about our organization's model and impact, we encourage you to watch the following video.

 **Program:** El Mercadito/Arcoiris

Mission Action is dedicated to advancing food justice and equity in our community through innovative programs and initiatives. Our signature projects, El Mercadito and Arcoiris, aim to empower local residents by providing access to healthy, culturally relevant food while fostering economic development and community resilience.

We are seeking a passionate and experienced Program Coordinator to lead our food justice initiatives, El Mercadito and Arcoiris. The ideal candidate will be committed to social justice, community engagement, and sustainability, with a background in program management and a deep understanding of food justice issues.

 **Key Responsibilities:**

* + With the Director of Community Services, manage food ordering and inventory for El Mercadito, coordinating with local suppliers and distributors to ensure timely and accurate deliveries.

* + Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment that prioritizes equity and respect.

* + Using established metrics, evaluate program success and regularly assess program impact.
	+ Prepare and present reports.

* + Advocate for policies and practices that support food justice at the local and regional levels.

* Commit yourself to treating each community member with respect and dignity.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

new_jobs.title: Assistant Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
**Job Summary:**

The Associate Project Manager supports the planning, coordination, and execution of civil construction projects, for electric utility installations. This role works closely with the project management team, field staff, subcontractors, and clients to ensure projects are delivered safely, on time, and within budget. The ideal candidate is organized, detail\-oriented, and eager to grow within the industry.

**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Support and execute project work plans and revises as appropriate to meet changing needs and requirements.
* Identify resource needs based on project assignments
* Manage schedules, cost, and customer demands
* Review deliverables prepared by team before passing to client or management personnel.
* Effectively apply project management methods to execute project schedules
* Develop and execute risk management plans thereby minimizing company exposure and risk on projects.
* Ensure project documents are accurate, complete, current, and stored appropriately.

**Project Accounting**

* Cost Management: Gather daily reports from field employees, electronically track production data using Excel, analyze data and generate cost reports. Track and report labor hours and expenses on a weekly basis.
* Manage project budget, Review scope changes, develop and track financial change orders
* Determine appropriate revenue recognition, ensures timely and accurate invoicing, and monitors receivables for project.
* Follow up with clients, when necessary, regarding unpaid invoices.
* Analyze project profitability, revenue, margins, bill rates and utilization.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Print job folders with all project documents.
* Creating and updating schedules for each project with input from PM, GF, and Foremen.
* Schedule and coordinate subcontractors and/or extra equipment required for work.
* Arrange and coordinate traffic control for field crews.
* Update and maintain system databases (Monday.com) on a daily basis.
* Cost and revenue tracking on a weekly basis.
* Generate invoices and submit change orders to client.
* Support client reporting needs on a daily/weekly basis.
* Tracking USA tickets for program. Renew as needed.
* Attend meetings to local client meetings and job walkdowns (in person or Teams).
* Create civil as\-built from foremen provided redlines. Compile as\-built package deliverables.

**Qualifications:**

* Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Project); experience with Microsoft Office, or similar scheduling software is a plus.
* Project management experience is a plus.
* Self motivated and a desire to learn new processes and concepts.
* Excellent communication, organizational, and problem\-solving skills.
* Ability to work on multiple projects in a fast\-paced environment.
* Experience with database and project management tools, such as Monday.com is a plus

**Compensation:**

Competitive salary based on experience, benefits package, training and career development opportunities.

Pay: $44\.00 \- $55\.00 per hour

Expected hours: No less than 40\.0 per week

Benefits:

* 401(k)
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Vision insurance

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have supporting construction in a utility field?
* Do you have experience in Microsoft Office? If so how many years?
* How have you supported project management in your past roles?
* This is a fully onsite role, are you comfortable commuting daily?

Work Location: In person

new_jobs.title: Key Account Manager - Critical Industries
new_jobs.description:
At **ABB**, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

**This position reports to:**


Strategic Program Director
\_\_


In this role, you’ll develop, implement, and manage the strategy and relationship with assigned data center\-related accounts for the ABB Electrification (EL) business, specifically related to the Industry, Building and Channel (IBC) organization. The position will have significant cross\-functional responsibilities across the ABB EL. As the point person for the ABB IBC relationship within those accounts, this position is responsible for growing share of wallet, profitability, and elevating customer satisfaction. Coordinates executive relationships within the accounts, sets goals, tracks pipeline, organizes sales activities, monitors current projects, and manages the resolution of the strategic customer challenges.


The work model for the role is: remote (\#LI\-Remote) and willingness to travel as needed is required.

**Your role and responsibilities:**

* **Lead Strategic Account Planning:** Develop and implement account plans and Statements of Work (SoW) to drive growth across divisions and locations.
* **Drive Customer\-Centric Sales Strategy:** Understand key business drivers and risks (e.g., sustainability, digitalization, cybersecurity) to shape tailored sales strategies and targets.
* **Build Trusted Relationships:** Engage decision\-makers within data center organizations, delivering comprehensive ABB solutions aligned with customer needs and profitability goals.
* **Enable Competitive \& Coordinated Execution:** Monitor market trends and competitors, apply standardized sales tools (e.g., Salesforce), and ensure a unified approach to sales planning and issue resolution.

**Our Team Dynamics**


Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters \- because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Marketing or related field and a minimum of 10 years of experience within the industry OR Associate’s degree and a minimum of 12 years of experience within the industry.
* Experience working with data center customers is a plus.
* Strong understanding of the Electrification products
* Proven ability to conduct market analysis and develop business plans with a structured, strategic mindset; experienced in building strong relationships with electrical contractors, distributors, and channel partners. Brings a technical background (preferably in the data center market), strong communication skills, and an agile, collaborative leadership style that fosters teamwork and innovation.
* Solid technical understanding of 3\-phase AC power systems including, but not limited to: medium and low voltage switchgear, medium and low voltage motor control centers, switchboards, panelboards, and ancillary electrical distribution products and experience with quoting projects for contractors  

Solid technical understanding and field sales experience selling power monitoring and control software, associated metering and communications systems, direct current, and battery energy storage/microgrid solutions.
* Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

**What's in it for you**

We empower you to take initiative, challenge ideas, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger

new_jobs.title: Outpatient Case Manager
new_jobs.description:
Description:
**Help Make a Lasting Impact**


Epiphany Center provides trauma\-informed, family\-centered services that support women and families as they build stability, strengthen recovery, and move toward greater independence.


We're looking for an **Outpatient Case Manager** to join our **Family Residence Outpatient Program**. In this role, you'll provide comprehensive case management and ongoing recovery support, helping clients connect with resources, navigate services, develop after\-care plans, and work toward their individual goals.

### **Why Join Epiphany?**

* Make a meaningful difference in the lives of women and families in recovery.
* Work as part of a supportive, multidisciplinary, trauma\-informed team.
* Build meaningful experience in behavioral health, substance use recovery, and case management.
* Help clients access community resources and services that support long\-term recovery and stability.
* Receive full\-time benefits including medical, dental, vision and life insurance, plus a 401(k) retirement plan.

### **What You'll Do**


As an Outpatient Case Manager, you'll work with the Family Residence Outpatient Program team to provide comprehensive case management and recovery support to clients and families.

* Provide ongoing case management and individualized support to clients.
* Meet regularly with clients to assess needs, identify goals, and support progress.
* Connect clients with community resources, services, and appropriate referrals.
* Coordinate with community providers and partner agencies, including social services and public health resources.
* Facilitate or support recovery\-focused and life\-skills groups.
* Develop and support **after\-care plans** to help clients maintain stability and recovery.
* Maintain timely, accurate, and confidential client records and documentation.
* Collaborate with multidisciplinary team members to coordinate services and address client needs.
* Maintain appropriate professional boundaries and client confidentiality.
* Participate in required staff meetings, trainings, and program activities.
* Follow Epiphany Center policies, safety procedures, confidentiality requirements, and trauma\-informed practices.

### **Compensation \& Schedule**

**Pay Range: $30\.00–$33\.00 per hour**


This is a **full\-time, on\-site position**.

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:30 a.m.–5:00 p.m.  

**Location:** San Francisco, CA — On\-Site  

**Program:** Family Residence Outpatient Program


Requirements:
**What You'll Bring**

* **High school diploma or equivalent.**
* **At least 2 years of relevant experience** working in behavioral health, substance use recovery, case management, social services, or a related setting.
* Current **registration or certification as an alcohol and other drug (AOD) counselor through CAADE, CCAPP, or CADTP.**
* Strong communication, organization, documentation, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work effectively as part of a multidisciplinary, trauma\-informed team.
* Ability to establish and maintain professional boundaries while building respectful relationships with clients from diverse backgrounds.
* Basic computer proficiency and ability to maintain timely and accurate documentation.

**Meet Network Right**


Network Right is the fractional IT team for the fastest\-growing, venture\-backed companies, including top AI startups and the VCs backing them.


We partner with startups as their dedicated IT function, handling day\-to\-day support while guiding long\-term strategy as they scale.


We've supported hundreds of startups from seed to acquisition, with clients trusting us to build secure, scalable IT foundations.


Founded by seasoned IT executives, we operate across the U.S. with offices in San Francisco and New York City.

**About the Role**


Network Right is looking for a Business Operations \& Office Management Intern to join our team for an approximately 3\-month engagement. This is a ground\-floor opportunity to work directly with our founders and contribute to real, high\-priority initiatives from day one.


We're open to both full\-time and part\-time arrangements depending on your situation.

**What You’ll Do**


Because we're a growing startup, no two days look the same. You'll get hands\-on exposure to how a scaling business operates from the inside, with a mix of project\-based and day\-to\-day responsibilities. Some of what you'll be working on:

* Business operations and special projects: Supporting key company initiatives and helping things run smoothly behind the scenes

* A genuine interest in tech, startups, and how a scaling business operates

* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail

* Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Business, Operations,

* **Compensation**: $20 per hour
* **Duration**: 3\-month internship with the potential to convert to a full\-time role after 90 days based on business needs

CloudKitchens helps restaurateurs around the world succeed in online food delivery \- our goal is to make food more affordable, higher quality, and convenient for everyone.



We take underutilized properties and transform them into smart kitchens so they can better serve restaurateurs, customers, and the neighborhoods they're in. Every time we launch a new facility we create jobs in that neighborhood, and we're proud to provide a wide range of cuisines and options for healthy food at an affordable price.



We're changing the game for restaurateurs, whether they're entrepreneurs opening their first restaurant, all the way through to your favorite global quick\-service restaurant chains.

new_jobs.title: Program Manager, Growth, Monetization & Strategic Initiatives
new_jobs.description:
From Fivetran's founding until now, our mission has remained the same: to make access to data as simple and reliable as electricity. With Fivetran, customer data arrives in their warehouses, canonical and ready to query, with no engineering or maintenance required. We're proud that more organizations continue to leverage our technology every day to become truly data\-driven.

  

**About Us**  

Fivetran and dbt Labs are bringing together two industry\-leading companies with a shared mission: helping organizations unlock the full value of their data.  

  

Together, we're delivering the data infrastructure layer that helps organizations move, transform, and trust their data — from the moment data moves, through every transformation, to the context teams and AI systems rely on.  

  

Fivetran helps organizations automate data movement across the systems, clouds, engines, and tools they rely on. dbt Labs pioneered analytics engineering, helping teams transform data into reliable, governed insights. Together, we support thousands of organizations as they build a trusted foundation for analytics, AI, and better business decisions.  

  

As we bring our teams and technology together, we're building on the strengths of both companies while continuing to deliver the products and experiences our customers know and trust. It's an exciting time to join us: we're creating a company with the scale, talent, and technology to help more organizations put their data to work with greater speed, confidence, and impact.  

  

During this transition period, you may see references to both Fivetran and dbt Labs throughout our recruiting process as we integrate our teams, systems, and career sites.

  


**About the Role**
------------------



Fivetran is building data pipelines to power the modern data stack for thousands of companies.

  



We're looking for a **Program Manager** to serve as the operational backbone of our pricing and monetization strategy in addition to supporting strategic initiatives, as needed. Sitting within Product Program Management and partnering closely with Analytics, Product, Sales, Product Marketing, RevOps, Finance, and Engineering, you'll own the cross\-functional execution that turns pricing strategy into well\-governed, shipped programs. You'll coordinate launches end to end, track commitments, resolve escalations, and expand the playbook that makes growth at Fivetran repeatable and scalable. This is a high\-visibility role for someone who thrives at the intersection of program management, GTM, and product strategy. You will be driving some of the most impactful business outcomes.

  



This is a full\-time, hybrid position based out of our Oakland, CA or Denver, CO office. Our hybrid work model offers a blend of remote flexibility and in\-person collaboration, including two days in the office each week to connect and build as a team.

  


**Technologies You'll Use**
---------------------------



Google Workspace(sheets)/Excel, Jira, Looker/Sigma/Hex, Notion, Salesforce and Slack.

  


**What You'll Do**
------------------


* Drive program governance, including running various meetings and decision\-making cadences.


* Lead Growth \& Monetization planning in close partnership with Sales \& Engineering leadership.


* Track program deliverables and commitments end to end.


* Coordinate engineering timelines, dependencies, and launch readiness with the ePMO.


* Partner with Product Marketing and RevOps on enablement plans and rollout execution.


* Manage sales escalations and the cross\-functional coordination required to resolve them.


* Partner with Finance and Analytics on analyses and ad hoc business metric requests from stakeholders across the organization.


* Report on outcomes, such as closed\-lost\-due\-to\-pricing and overall pricing impact.


* Expand upon and further operationalize Fivetran's pricing and program management playbooks.

  


**Skills We're Looking For**
----------------------------


* Proven experience in program management or product operations, ideally supporting pricing, monetization, or GTM initiative in B2B SaaS and with consumption based pricing.


* A track record of driving cross\-functional execution across Product, Sales, Marketing, and Engineering.


* Excellent stakeholder management and executive communication, including tracking and reporting on commitments to senior leadership.


* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret pricing and revenue data and translate it into clear insights and recommendations.


* Experience establishing operating rhythms, governance processes, and repeatable playbooks.


* Familiarity with GTM and RevOps tooling and processes (e.g., Salesforce, CPQ, and BI tools such as Looker).


* Highly organized and self\-directed, able to manage multiple concurrent programs in a fast\-paced environment.

  


**Bonus Skills**
----------------

* Experience in data processing (ETL, ELT) and/or cloud\-based platforms


* PMP Certified



\#LI\-HYBRID

  

**Perks and Benefits**


* 100% employer\-paid medical insurance**\***
* Generous paid time away from work, including paid vacation or flexible/unlimited vacation depending on role and country, plus paid sick time, inclusive parental leave, paid holidays, including a year\-end Global Week of Rest, and volunteer days off.
* RSU stock grants\*
* Professional development and training opportunities
* Company virtual happy hours, free food, and fun team\-building activities
* Monthly cell phone stipend
* Access to an innovative mental health support platform that offers personalized care and resources in areas such as: therapy, coaching, and self\-guided mindfulness exercises for all covered employees and their covered dependents.


* *May vary by country and worker type \- please reach out to your recruiter for more information*


*Click* *here* *to learn more about Fivetran's Benefits by Region.*



We're honored to be valued at over $5\.6 bil

City: Santa Clara

Wipro Limited (NYSE: WIT, BSE: 507685, NSE: WIPRO) is a leading technology services and consulting company focused on building innovative solutions that address clients’ most complex digital transformation needs. With over 230,000 employees and business partners across 65 countries, we deliver on the promise of helping our customers, colleagues, and communities thrive in an ever\-changing world. For additional information, visit us at www.wipro.com.  

Quick Turn Program Manager


We are looking for a Quick Turn Program Manager (QTPM) to join QTPM Execution team. Our work has a major impact across all functional areas. We need passionate, hard\-working, and creative people to help us reach our Speed of Light (SOL) goals.

  

What you will be doing:


* Drive Speed of Light (SOL) execution at Contract Manufacturers (CM) to deliver zero manufacturing defects for New Product Introduction (NPI) boards and systems assemblies. Work with cross\-functional teams to support local Quick Turn (QT) and Mass Production (MP) products and handle all aspects of board and system assemblies.
* Champion continuous improvement at the CM to reduce waste.
* Be the primary Operations subject matter expert to drive CM readiness and prepare for production ramp or new product launch. Drive execution to higher operational efficiency and improve daily going rate (DGR), to achieve quality standard and reliable delivery for boards \& system assemblies.
* Coordinates resource, prioritizes activities, and establishes schedules to complete assignments. Responsible for clear to build and build schedule. Manage multiple QT/MP/Rework/RMA Builds locally and overseas (CM).
* Attend daily WIP Call with the factory. Provide daily communication and status to Board Program Manager (BPM) or Requestors.
* Initiate Special Build Instructions, coordinate ECOs and confirm updates after BOM comparisons are complete. Provide shipment ETA, tracking information to BPM/requestors, and closely monitors Critical Shipments.
* Conduct Control Run Readiness Reviews and Manage Control Run Builds. Coordinate board test for CM. Follow up with BPM/LDE for test diagnostics \& Vbios, works with SQE/CM for test results. Feedback any failures to LDE/BPM.
* Lead regular reviews and ensure all risks associated with the product are identified and closed or mitigated to enable the quality ramp of a product. Managing all operational issues; advancing key issues and present options for resolution to the cross\-functional teams.
* Create \& Issue Supplier Corrective Action Request (SCAR) \& drive closure, as needed. Reviewing all open 8D, during weekly Quality \& On Time Deliver (OTD) critical metric meetings. Maintain asset \& equipment lists, Bi\-weekly asset cycle verification

* 7\+ years of working experience in the Contract Manufacturing or Production planning field.
* Bachelor of Science degree in Operations, Manufacturing Management, Logistics or related fields, or equivalent experience.
* Must function independently in a multifaceted and fast paced environment.
* Ability to take ownership of tasks, to resolve time sensitive issues in a dynamic production environment.
* Very strong leadership, facilitation, problem solving, and project management skills are required to be successful in this role. Strong interpersonal skills, enjoy working with others in a collaborative, social environment; effective at building and maintaining strong relationships.
* Be solution driven. Apply problem solving skills to work through conflict in an effective and professional manner to maintain productive working relationships.
* Proficiency in business software applications such as Microsoft Office, Excel, SAP, MRP – Excellent analytical skills and hands\-on with excel to analyze data \- formulas, pivot tables. Ability to write excels macros is a plus.
* Language: Excellent English skills on reading, writing, speaking, and listening
* Personality: highly organized, detailed orientated, a self\-starter with a strong sense of ownership.
* APICS, Six Sigma, Lean Manufacturing certification is helpful.
* Flexibility and willingness to travel as the need arise.

new_jobs.title: Front End Operations Specialist
new_jobs.description:
Albertsons' Northern California Market has an opening for a Front End Operations Specialist.



The Front End Operations Specialist (also referred to as Assistant Customer Service Manager) provides positive and proactive leadership and instruction in Customer Service, Retail Integrity, and Operations. Responsible for enhancing the customer service experience, ensuring retail integrity, and achieving budget goals for labor, cash variation, check expense, and supplies across all stores. Oversee the implementation of customer service initiatives. Mentor, develop, and train Store Execution and Retail Integrity Managers to maintain operational excellence and maximize sales and profits. Ensure compliance with company policies, procedures, and applications in the front\-end.


**Responsibilities**


* Promote a Service First, Second to None culture among Market staff and store associates.
* Direct and monitor store service performance using tools like Customer SAT and service shops.
* Create a customer service culture and environment.
* Provide coaching and training to improve store customer service performance.
* Establish clear objectives with accountability commitments.
* Direct special service operations events such as Service Challenge, area meetings, and Store of the Year.
* Communicate customer expectations and opportunities.
* Develop Market plans and metrics to exceed customer expectations.
* Measure Market performance against plans and metrics.
* Responsible for service content in the Market monthly newsletter.
* Serve as the communication interface between Boise Store Support and the Market.
* Participate in Market, Area, and store meetings, providing verbal and written communication to Market and store personnel.
* Train and mentor staff.
* Plan and facilitate the ongoing development of Service Execution Managers, Retail Integrity Managers, Trainees, Store Service Operations Managers, Service Assistants, and Scan Coordinators.
* Implement and measure the Company’s Core Values through team building, solid training programs, and communication across all departments.
* Ensure compliance with company policies and procedures, including cash management, retail integrity, and adherence to state and federal regulations.
* Oversee all advertisements ensuring promotional information is supported by the Host pricing system and POS Systems.
* Partner with Loss Prevention to address and resolve operational violations and investigations.
* Collaborate with Execution Operations Managers and Installation Services Teams to coordinate the installation of store systems equipment within the Market.

  

  

**Qualifications**



Education Level: Bachelor’s degree in business, finance or related field and/or at least 5 years’ experience in retail store operations preferred.



Experience Level: Experience as a Store Director or Assistant Store Director is helpful



Skills and Experiences


* Financial acumen and analytical skills combined with attention to detail.
* Thorough knowledge of front\-end work methods, fund handling, and scanning procedures.
* Understanding of company scanning and price maintenance support application systems and practices.
* Previous experience in retail store operations with a strong background in scan coordination procedures and methods, preferably with a Retail Scanning Company.
* Complete knowledge of front\-end company policies and procedures.
* Ability to complete store bookkeeping duties.
* Ability to work effectively in a team environment and build relationships.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills to interface with personnel at all levels.
* Proficiency in PC skills and desktop applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
* Analytical ability.


Travel Requirements: Frequent travel dependent upon geography



Physical Environment


* Most work is performed in a temperature\-controlled office or retail store environment.
* Store visits involve regular standing, walking, climbing stairs, and movement around machinery and hazardous equipment, as well as backstage receiving and production areas.
* Incumbent may sit for long periods at a desk or computer terminal.
* Use of calculators, keyboards, telephones, and other office equipment is required during the normal workday.
* Stopping, bending, twisting, and reaching may be required to complete job duties.

  

  

Albertsons Companies' Northern California Market office is located in Pleasanton, CA and supports the operations of 285 retail stores across northern California, northwestern Nevada, and Hawaii under the Safeway, Andronico’s, Vons, and Pak ‘n Save Foods banners.

  

**Why you will choose us**  

Albertsons Companies has always been a people\-oriented business, and thoughtful people practices remain a core element of our company’s philosophy. As friendly, enthusiastic people who enjoy offering customers an exceptional shopping experience, we provide world\-class customer service each and every day.



We also provide a variety of benefits including:


* Diverse and inclusive work culture
* Competitive pay with weekly payroll
* Access to up to 50% of your earned wages before payday, via our partnership with Stream
* Associate discounts
* Comprehensive benefits for eligible associates, including Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k), and more (eligibility details at myACI Benefits: https://myaci\-benefits.com)
* Paid time off: vacation, holidays, and sick leave (eligibility details at myACI Benefits: https://myaci\-benefits.com)
* Leaders invested in your training, career growth \& development

Candidates with unique qualifications may be considered for compensation above this range. Benefits may include medical, dental, vision, disability and life insurance, sick pay, PTO/Vacation Pay or Flexible Time Off, paid holidays, bereavement pay, and retiremen

new_jobs.title: Customer Experience Coordinator - San Jose, CA
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT VEG**



In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we've expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!



At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open\-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer\-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.



This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.



VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

  


**THE JOB**



As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer's experience through service, focus, and participation—so, you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say yes and put patient and customer experience above all else. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

  


**WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online

* Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

* High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly

* Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors
* Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

new_jobs.title: Account Manager - Home Health
new_jobs.description:
Health Link Home Health \& Hospice  
Milpitas / Santa Clara County, CA  
Full\-Time \| $41/hour \+ Performance\-Based Bonus  


The Role  


For over 20 years, Health Link Home Health \& Hospice has served patients throughout the San Francisco Bay Area. We are seeking a motivated, relationship\-driven Account Manager to join our Community Relations team and support continued growth throughout Santa Clara County.  


Working closely with the Director of Business Development, the Account Manager will focus on developing and maintaining relationships with healthcare providers, increasing awareness of Health Link's home health services, and generating new referral opportunities throughout the South Bay.  


This is a field\-based role for someone who enjoys building relationships, connecting with healthcare professionals, and developing business within the community. We are looking for someone who is motivated, consistent, organized, and comfortable being accountable for growth goals.  


You will be supported with a company vehicle, ongoing training, and AI\-powered technology designed to provide referral insights and support efficient territory routing.  


What You'll Do  
Develop and maintain referral relationships throughout assigned areas of Santa Clara County  
Build relationships with hospitals, skilled nursing facilities, physicians, medical groups, clinics, senior living communities, and other healthcare organizations  
Conduct consistent in\-person outreach, account visits, meetings, presentations, and follow\-up  
Introduce new healthcare partners to Health Link and educate them on our home health services, clinical programs, and capabilities  
Maintain regular communication with existing referral partners and strengthen those relationships over time  
Identify new referral opportunities through consistent field outreach and relationship building  
Follow up with prospective referral partners and maintain consistent account contact  
Execute territory priorities and business development initiatives in partnership with the Director of Business Development  
Communicate feedback from referral partners, market activity, and potential growth opportunities to the Director of Business Development  
Collaborate with Intake, Clinical, Operations, and other internal teams to support a strong referral and patient experience  
Meet established referral, admission, and account growth goals  
Represent Health Link professionally throughout the South Bay healthcare community  
What You'll Need  
1\+ year of experience in healthcare sales, business development, account management, community relations, or a related healthcare role preferred  
Strong relationship\-building and communication skills  
Sales\-oriented mindset with the motivation to develop new business and grow referral relationships  
Comfortable conducting in\-person outreach and developing new professional relationships  
Strong follow\-up, organization, and time\-management skills  
Self\-motivated and comfortable working independently in the field  
Knowledge of the Santa Clara County healthcare market preferred  
Existing relationships within the South Bay healthcare community are a plus  
Home health, hospice, post\-acute care, senior care, hospital, or skilled nursing experience preferred  
Valid California driver's license and driving record that meets company requirements  
Benefits  
Performance\-based bonus opportunity  
Company vehicle  
AI\-powered technology to support referral insights and efficient territory routing  
Medical, dental, vision, and life insurance  
401(k) with company matching  
Paid time off

Sr. Technical Account Manager, TAM
new_jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Would you like to join one of the fastest\-growing organizations within Amazon Web Services (AWS) and help customers across all industries and sizes—including Automotive, Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare, Industrial and Manufacturing, Media and Entertainment, Telecom, Big Data, and more—gain the best value and service from AWS?
  

  

At AWS Enterprise Support, we're looking for a Sr. Technical Account Manager (TAM) to support and influence our customers' creative and transformative spirit of innovation across all technology areas, including Compute, Storage, Database, Big Data, AI/ML, Application\-level Services, Networking, Serverless, and more. This is not a sales role, but rather an opportunity to be the principal technical advisor and 'voice of the customer' to organizations ranging from start\-ups to Fortune 500 enterprises—serving as their advocate to AWS product teams.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

As a Senior TAM, you will craft and execute technical cloud strategies to drive customers adoption and use of AWS services. Your technical acumen and customer\-facing skills will enable you to effectively represent AWS at our customer, and drive discussions with senior leadership regarding operational excellence, cloud maturity, support, and risk management.  

  

You will provide advocacy and strategic technical guidance to plan and build solutions using best practices, and proactively keep the customers AWS environments operationally healthy. The close relationships developed with your customers will allow you to understand their business/operational needs and technical challenges, and help them achieve the greatest value from AWS. This position will require the ability to travel 10% or more as needed.  

  

The TAM is the centerpiece of value to our Enterprise Support customers. If you wish to be at the forefront of innovation, come join us!  

  

About AWS  

Diverse Experiences  

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.  

Why AWS?  

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.  

Inclusive Team Culture  

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee\-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.  

Mentorship \& Career Growth  

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.  

Work/Life Balance  

We value work\-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.  

  

About the team  

See more information about our team here: https://w.amazon.com/bin/view/Plus/tams/

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 5\+ years of design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience
* 5\+ years of technical engineering experience

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in a 24x7 operational services or support environment
* Experience in internal enterprise or external customer\-facing environment as a technical lead
* Experience with AWS services or other cloud offerings
* Understanding of the AWS Well\-Architected Framework pillars and ability to properly apply them to existing or new customer architecture, implementations, and/or solutions

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. Criminal history may have a direct, adverse, and negative relationship with some of the material job duties of this position. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. Pursuant to the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  

  

Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodation

new_jobs.title: Office Manager
new_jobs.description:
Navi captures everything a pilot sees and hears and turns it into automated debrief intelligence. The platform is live at flight schools, business jet operators, and the U.S. Air Force. All of it runs out of one office in San Francisco — and you're the person who makes that office work.

**About the role**
==================


This is the first operations hire at Navi, and it's a role you grow into as fast as you can carry it. You own the physical company: the space, the vendors, the supplies, the food, the visitors, the gear. You also give the founders back their time — calendars, travel, expenses, and the hundred small things that would otherwise eat a founder's afternoon.


You'll be the first person in the office and the reason everyone else's day is frictionless. Engineers shouldn't be ordering monitors. Founders shouldn't be booking flights. You handle it before anyone has to ask.


This is not a role where you wait for a ticket. You notice, and you fix it.

**What you'll do**
==================

* Run the San Francisco office day to day — space, supplies, snacks and meals, mail, equipment, and everything else that keeps a team of builders heads\-down
* Own vendor and building relationships — landlord, cleaners, caterers, IT, furniture, whatever we need next
* Host everyone who walks through the door — customers, pilots, investors, defense partners, candidates — and make Navi feel as sharp in person as it does in the product
* Support the founders directly — calendar management, travel booking, expense reports, and keeping the week from falling apart
* Own Navi merch end to end — inventory, reorders, quality, and getting the right gear to customers, events, new hires, and the team
* Get new hires set up before day one — desk, laptop, badge, swag, and a first week that feels intentional
* Plan team offsites, dinners, and the rituals that hold a fast\-moving company together
* Build the systems that make all of this repeatable as the team doubles, and then doubles again

**About you**
=============

* 2–4 years in an office management, operations, executive assistant, or hospitality role — you've kept something real running
* Ridiculously organized, with a system for everything and nothing dropped
* You anticipate. You see the problem a week out and it's solved before anyone notices there was one
* Comfortable owning a founder's calendar and travel, and exercising judgment on their behalf
* Warm and unflappable in person — you're the first impression Navi makes on a four\-star general and on a 19\-year\-old student pilot
* You take pride in the details: how the office smells, how the hoodie fits, how the coffee tastes
* You want to be onsite, every day, because the job is the room

**Nice to have**
================

* Startup experience, especially as an early or first ops hire
* Experience with vendor negotiation or merch and apparel sourcing
* Comfort with modern tooling — Ashby, Notion, Slack, Google Workspace, Brex or Ramp
* Event planning, hospitality, or aviation background

**Why this role matters**
=========================


Every hour a founder or engineer spends on logistics is an hour not spent shipping. This role is leverage: you take the entire operational surface of the company onto your shoulders so the rest of the team can go fast. And every person who ever visits Navi — the customer deciding whether to deploy, the candidate deciding whether to join, the investor deciding whether to write the check — forms their impression in a room you built.

**What you'll get**
===================

* Early\-stage equity — real ownership in a category\-defining company
* Flight training — earn your pilot's license on us
* The first ops seat at a company that will need a whole operations function, and a role that scales with it
* Impact you can see — you're building the place where aviation's new standard gets made

**How we work**
===============

* **Find a way.** We don't wait for permission or perfect information. Ideas come from anywhere regardless of title. Figure it out, ship it, iterate.
* **Creativity over control.** First principles over process. We'd rather have a creative solution that's 80% right today than a perfect one next quarter.
* **Update fast.** Come in with a hypothesis, throw it away when the data says otherwise. Ego has no place here.
* **Intensity with focus.** We work hard because the mission demands it. Clarity on what matters is how we make that sustainable.

**About the Office of the City Administrator:**  

**The Office of the City Administrator**includes 20\+ agencies and over 1,000 dedicated staff who provide essential services to San Francisco residents and businesses and improve the administration of government.  

  

**Our Mission**  

The City Administrator’s Office is strongly committed to ensuring efficient and effective government services, increasing the City’s safety and resiliency, strengthening the local economy, supporting equity and inclusion, and optimizing the City’s capital planning and infrastructure.

**Our Vision**


We are committed to ensuring that the City's services are inclusive, efficient, equitable, and culturally competent for San Franciscans of all races, ethnic backgrounds, religions, and sexual orientations. This commitment requires comprehensive review and thorough analysis of existing practices and policies to remove barriers to real inclusion.


We are also committed to ensuring that the Department is a safe, equitable, and inclusive workplace for individuals of all races. This includes creating opportunities for hiring, promotion, retention, training, and development, for all employees, including but not limited to Black, Indigenous, and people of color (BIPOC).


To learn more about our departments, divisions, and programs, visit: https://sf.gov/departments/city\-administrator

**About DataSF:**


Want to build robust and scalable data infrastructure to power data\-driven City services? Join the DataSF team to empower and expand the use of data in government!


DataSF’s mission is to transform the way San Francisco works with data. We believe that data, when harnessed effectively, can improve transparency, resident engagement, and government performance. We are committed to removing barriers and making it easier for all people to access services and knowledge, and we actively seek team members whose diverse life experiences reflect the residents we serve. The department has a hybrid work schedule.  

  

DataSF runs the City’s open data program and the Unified Data Platform (UDP), the shared space where departments build, manage, and use trusted data together. Our work supports citywide priorities such as permitting, street coordination, and public safety. The Data Enablement Operations Analyst will be part of our data enablement practice, working closely with the Enablement Principal, who sets the strategy for how departments adopt and use the platform. This position will execute that strategy day\-to\-day. Much of this work happens inside partner departments: sitting with analysts, learning how their work actually functions, helping them get productive on the platform, and bringing learnings back to the team. Over time, we expect the Data Enablement Operations Analyst to automate repetitive workflows so routine tasks run independently and the team’s focus stays on supporting departments.

* Manage intake for the enablement practice: triage incoming requests using our service tiers, keep departments informed about status, and ensure every request has a clear owner.
* Onboard departments to the UDP from first conversation through active use. This includes coordinating agreements, processing access requests, leading kickoff and follow\-up, and spending time with analysts during their first weeks on the platform.
* Support our governance processes by coordinating data‑sharing agreements and keeping the citywide dataset and enterprise system inventories accurate, current, and published.
* Build self‑service guides and documentation so the most frequent questions are answered before anyone needs to submit a request.
* Coordinate our training program: schedule cohorts, track attendance, and collect feedback that shapes what and how we teach.
* Improve the operation itself by identifying manual, repetitive steps and creating automation that replaces them.

The Mid\-Market Program Manager owns the end\-to\-end operational performance of Harbor IT's mid\-market POD: the clients in it, the delivery staff who serve them, the projects running inside it, and the service delivery workflows that hold it together. * Mid\-Market Program Manager: POD delivery performance, SLA and KPI attainment, the delivery team, the POD's PMO and project outcomes, PSA data integrity, delivery margin inputs, and renewal execution.

* Own PSA hygiene for the POD: enforce ticket quality standards (notes, categorization, resolution documentation), time entry accuracy and timeliness, and correct work type classification. The Program Manager is accountable if the data in the PSA is wrong.
* Own the financial inputs of POD delivery: drive delivery staff utilization to target, enforce 95 percent or better time entry accuracy, manage agreement utilization, identify out\-of\-scope billing opportunities, and ensure contract compliance. This role directly impacts service margin.
* Build and maintain service delivery SOPs, escalation playbooks, ticket handling standards, and onboarding documentation for the POD. This role is expected to create operational structure, not inherit it.
* Analyze ticketing and incident trends, identify root causes, and drive remediation through proactive service improvement, delivering a defined number of CSI (continual service improvement) actions each quarter.
* Own client communication during major incidents, planned maintenance, and other impactful events, and own the post\-incident RCA and follow\-through on corrective actions.

**About Assembly Software**
Assembly Software is the team behind Neos, the case management platform purpose\-built for personal injury law firms, with embedded intelligence that already knows your cases. We're trusted by 1,100 firms and 15,000 users nationwide, backed by more than 40 years of experience in PI case management. As a growing SaaS company with a passionate team, we're building software that makes cases easier to manage and outcomes better for the firms and clients who rely on it.


When you join Assembly Software, you’re joining a team that genuinely cares about you, your career, and your excitement about your job. When you work for a tech company in the legal field, there are endless opportunities ripe for disruption, and you’ll be on the forefront of that innovation. We want you to pursue what drives you and push your boundaries! Assembly Software is where people come to shake up a historically buttoned\-up industry. **Vision Statement**
Assembly's vision is to provide the legal community the best practice management software that enables client advocacy from anywhere at anytime. **Mission Statement**
Our mission is to provide intuitive and comprehensive legal practice management solutions enhancing efficiency and profitability for our customers. **Core Values*** We are Accountable: We accept responsibility for our choices and actions. We value transparency \+ feedback.
* We Never Stop Learning: We pursue growth \+ learning.
* We Thrive as a Team: We value others' opinions \+ work respectfully with one another.
* We are Collaborative Innovators: We are adventurous, creative \+ open\-minded.
* We are Here to Be of Service to our Customer \+ our Colleagues: No matter our role, we are all here to be of service \+ add value.
* We have Unyielding Integrity: We do the right thin, even when no one is watching.
* We Embrace Diversity \+ Inclusion: We are passionate about creating and cultivating an inclusive culture that promotes and values diversity.
  

As our People Operations Manager at Assembly Software, you'll own the operational core of how Assembly hires, pays and supports its people. This is a growth\-track role. We're hiring the person we expect to become our Director of Employee Operations and who will grow with our organization.

**What You'll Do**


You'll run payroll, benefits and HR operations, and own onboarding and offboarding end to end. You'll lead recruiting for every role below Director level, with recruiter support that can flex up and down with demand. On employee relations and performance management, you'll partner closely with our EVP, Human Resources: you handle policy questions, everyday concerns and performance documentation, higher\-risk matters stay with the EVP, and that line moves as trust builds. Once the core runs smoothly, you'll map our people processes, fix what slows them down, and lead the rollout of the tools that support them.

**What You'll Bring**


You have four to seven or more years in HR or People Operations, with hands\-on experience running payroll and benefits and owning full\-cycle recruiting, not just scheduling. You have sound judgment on employee relations and know what to handle yourself and what to raise. You spot broken processes and fix them, you already use AI as a working tool, and you want a bigger role while understanding that the fundamentals are how you earn it.

**Why Now**


Our foundation is strong and our direction is clear. What we need now is an operator who keeps the core running cleanly while building the systems that let us grow without adding headcount to run them. The processes you build in your first year will shape how every future Assembly employee is hired, paid and supported.

 **When you’re considering a new job, it’s normal to have questions. Here are a few things we get asked all of the time:** **1\. I'm tired of the daily commute. Where are you located?**  

Assembly Software is a fully remote company. We work across time zones and connect through Teams, so you can build your career from wherever you do your best work: home office, favorite coffee shop, or yes, in your PJs if that's your vibe.

 **2\. What makes Assembly Software different?**  

Our people. We're a fast growing SaaS company and the leading provider of case management solutions for personal injury and legal firms. Through our three brands, Neos, Needles, and TrialWorks, we serve over 2,500 law firms and 40,000\+ users, the largest user base in the industry. Backed by Ridge Road Partners since 2017, we combine decades of legal tech expertise with a scrappy, entrepreneurial energy. We move fast, we care about the product, and we have fun doing it. Our sales team also enjoys uncapped commission with built in accelerators, so top performers are rewarded for their impact.

 **3\. What's the benefits package like?**  

Competitive and comprehensive. You'll have access to:

* Medical, dental, and vision plans
* Short and long term disability coverage
* Supplemental insurance options
* 401(k)
* Flexible time off
* Paid parental leave
* An Employee Assistance Program


We invest in our people because we know our results depend on them. When you do great work here, you'll be recognized and rewarded for it.

 *Assembly Software provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.*

The **Clinical Support Specialist (CSS)** partners with clinical and operational teams to complete a variety of functions that support the Monogram care model and excellent patient experience. * Oversee and facilitate all Monogram clinician\-driven orders including external referrals, prior authorizations, lab orders, prescriptions, durable medical equipment (DME), etc.

new_jobs.description:
**Position Summary**

Dassian is creating a new first\-line leadership role to own the health of its existing customer base: renewals, support escalation, and Innovation Managed Services (IMS) usage. This is not a sales\-growth role. It is a retention, service\-quality, and account\-health role that sits between Dassian's Customer Success Managers and executive leadership, and it will govern how the Customer Success Manager role itself is run going forward. Compensation is deliberately structured with no commission on new sales, to keep this role focused on protecting existing revenue and enforcing contract scope rather than chasing bookings.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Team and Function Leadership**

* Directly manage the Customer Success Manager team (currently two CSMs); set their goals, run their reviews, and coach them on account planning and renewal execution.
* Establish and enforce a quarterly business review (QBR) cadence across the full account book; this was flagged as "a new goal this year" with no owner before this role existed.
* Define the KPI set for the CSM function beyond price increases: retention rate, QBR completion, IMS utilization, and escalation resolution time.

**Contract and Maintenance Scope Governance**

* Serve as the first point of escalation for customers who are dissatisfied with a delivery or support answer, so those conversations stop routing directly to the CEO by default.
* Hold the line on contract and maintenance scope: determine what is in\-scope support versus billable work, and document the decision and rationale each time.
* Partner with Solutions Delivery to flag recurring scope\-creep patterns (e.g., customer\-driven unauthorized system changes) and build a standard response process for them.

**IMS and Recurring Revenue Health**

* Own usage enablement and reporting for all 7 current IMS accounts; today no one tracks or drives this, and one account has already failed to renew as a result.
* Build a simple usage/health dashboard per IMS account and review it with each customer at least quarterly.

new_jobs.description:
**Who We Are**


TrueComp partners with over 1,000 public sector agencies to modernize workforce planning, compensation, and benefits analysis. Its intuitive platform and expert consulting empower HR and finance leaders with transparency, efficiency, and equity to make smarter decisions in recruitment, retention, and budgeting. TrueComp provides instant and actionable insights to help government organizations attract top talent, optimize labor strategies, and achieve long\-term fiscal sustainability. Dedicated to simplifying workforce challenges, TrueComp’s solutions enable data\-driven decisions that improve organizational performance and drive meaningful outcomes. TrueComp was recognized among the Top 100 Government Services companies on the 2024 Inc. 5000\. **About the role*** **About the role**
* The Customer Success Manager owns a book of 50\-75 public agency accounts from the point a customer has produced real work in the platform through renewal. They are accountable for retention and adoption across that book.
* Our customers are HR directors, finance directors, and the analysts who support them. They use TrueComp to price union proposals, build salary schedules, and defend numbers in front of elected officials. Success in this role depends on being credible in those conversations, not just responsive to them.
* Roughly 15\-20 accounts are named accounts managed on a set cadence. The remainder are covered through scheduled check\-ins and usage\-based triggers. Every account renews annually and the Customer Success Manager owns that conversation start to finish.
* This role reports to the Chief Operations Officer and works closely with sales, support, and product.

**What you'll do** **Retention and Renewal**

* Own the renewal conversation for every account in your book, from early positioning through signed agreement.
* Run a renewal calendar that starts 120 days out, not 30\. In public sector, the paperwork takes longer than the decision.
* Negotiate pricing and terms within your approved authority, and bring anything outside that band to the COO with a recommendation.
* Manage the mechanics — purchase orders, fiscal year timing, contract amendments, and re\-bid requirements where they apply.
* Forecast renewals accurately and identify risk early enough to change the outcome.
* Maintain an account health view you can defend in a forecast review.

**Customer Relationships**

* Build working relationships with HR and finance leadership at each agency, not just your day\-to\-day contact.
* Understand each customer's operating calendar — budget adoption, bargaining cycles, council meetings — and plan engagement around it.
* Run a consistent cadence with named accounts covering usage, upcoming budget and negotiation cycles, and open issues.
* Own escalations end to end, pulling in support, product, or executive help when the situation calls for it.
* Identify and qualify expansion opportunities across additional modules, added agencies, and consulting engagements, and hand them to sales with the context needed to run them.

**Collaboration and Product Input**

* Route customer feedback and feature requests into the roadmap process with enough context and evidence for product and engineering to act.
* Work alongside the Onboarding Specialist from kickoff forward so the transition to your ownership is a handoff, not a reintroduction.
* Share patterns you see across your book with the broader team — recurring friction, competitive pressure, emerging use cases.

**Process and Tools**

* Track account activity, renewal forecasts, and escalations in Salesforce and keep records current.
* Contribute to building the customer success playbook. We are a 30\-person company and you will help define process, not just follow it.

**Qualifications*** Direct experience inside or alongside public sector HR or finance. That may be working at an agency, or working with agency HR and finance teams in a vendor, consulting, or advisory capacity.
* Working knowledge of compensation benchmarking, labor costing, or actuarial analysis. You do not need to be an actuary. You do need to hold your own in a conversation with a compensation analyst.
* Direct ownership of renewal outcomes in a prior role, including pricing conversations and negotiation.
* Working knowledge of public sector procurement — purchase orders, fiscal year cycles, contract amendments, and when a renewal becomes a competitive re\-bid.
* 3\-5 years managing customer relationships with direct retention and renewal accountability. SaaS experience preferred, not required.
